A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same SWE-Gym study. Their main text, tables, figures, equations, and Appendices A–B support reliable comparison despite substantial reorganization.

before.justification: v1 reports original agent-training experiments, SWE-Bench evaluations, verifier experiments, and training-data ablations, including Table 3 and Figures 3–8.

after.justification: v2 retains original agent and verifier evaluations, self-improvement experiments, and scaling analyses in its main text and appendices.

M1.justification: Rejection-sampling fine-tuning, OpenHands and MoatlessTools scaffolds, per-instance capping, and verifier-based trajectory selection remain unchanged. The appendix verifier prompts are identical; rewritten explanations do not establish a procedural change.

E1.justification: Both versions train using SWE-Gym and its Lite subset and evaluate on SWE-Bench Lite and Verified. The represented repositories, Python domain, and issue-resolution tasks remain unchanged.

E2.justification: Table 9 retains the same RAG/SWE-Llama and Lingma comparisons, while Appendix A retains the Ma and Golubev comparisons. Zero-shot baselines and comparator membership within the ablations are also unchanged.

E3.justification: The stated stuck-in-loop criterion changes from repeating an action in the last three turns (v1 Section 3.2) to three consecutive repetitions (v2 Section 4.2), dropping the terminal-turn restriction. Other settings remain unchanged; identical Table 3 values do not establish that evaluation was rerun.

E4.justification: Capping, self-improvement, verifier-data composition, LoRA versus full fine-tuning, and data-diversity analyses are retained. For example, v1 Table 4 becomes v2 Table 6, and v1 Figures 3, 5, and 8 become appendix Figures 6, 8, and 9.

E5.justification: Both retain Table 3 uncertainty estimates and Appendix B.1's mean-and-variance calculation over 100 randomly selected rollout subsets, including the first-rollout exception. No seed, repeated-run, or statistical reporting procedure is added or revised.

E6.justification: Table 1 and the dataset overview change SWE-Gym Raw's reported size from 66,894 to 64,689, resolving v1's disagreement with its construction section. Matched benchmark tables, scaling curves, and ablation results otherwise retain their values.

T1.justification: The trajectory representation and normalized YES/NO reward formula remain mathematically equivalent. Neither version introduces additional theoretical assumptions, propositions, derivations, or proofs.

C1.justification: The central claims remain SWE-Gym's novelty as a training environment, effectiveness across agent scaffolds, and support for agent training and inference-time scaling. The headline 32.0% Verified and 26.0% Lite results and open-weight state-of-the-art claim are retained.

C2.justification: v2 Section 6 explicitly discusses restricted repository/task/language diversity, modest self-improvement, and missing human collaboration. It also adds deployment qualifications and removes v1's hypothesis that overweighting negative examples makes verifiers overly conservative.

D1.justification: v2 removes the direct SWE-Gym project URL and MoatlessTools version 0.0.2 disclosure, while newly identifying the annotators as a subset of the authors. Most training hyperparameters, hardware information, sampling details, and prompts remain in reorganized Appendix B.

R1.justification: v2 removes the Li et al. (2022), Snell et al. (2022), and Zhou et al. (2024) citations and references. The central positioning against existing SWE resources and the detailed concurrent-work comparison in Appendix A remain substantially unchanged.

P1.justification: The introduction, related work, dataset description, and experimental exposition are extensively rewritten and condensed. Related Work moves from Section 5 to Section 2, appendix training details are reorganized, and the conclusion expands into limitations and future work alongside a new Impact Statement.

P2.justification: Multiple figures and the capping table move from the main text to the appendix. The MoatlessTools 32B panel is separately redisplayed in v2 Figure 4 while the full original comparison remains in Figure 7. Training-data plots are redrawn with linear percentage axes replacing logarithmic axes, and table formatting and captions change.

improvement.justification: v2 resolves the contradictory SWE-Gym Raw count, clarifies the exposition, and adds substantive applicability limitations in Section 6. These provide modest gains in clarity and qualification, partly offset by removing the project link and scaffold-version detail. The underlying experimental evidence is essentially unchanged.
